interactables.text: The [Husband], Derek, lifts one headphone. 'Something heavy rattled past in the hall around [seven]. Cart wheels. The maid with the dinner service, probably. Didn't look. Wasn't my problem.'
A crew manifest on the dresser. Multiple names. One line stands out: '[D. Marsh] - 2x Acoustic Cases (sound-proof) - [7:00 PM].'
Massive road cases. The label reads: '[Acoustic Isolation] - No Sound Transmission.' You press an ear to the surface. Silence. Whatever's inside, you wouldn't hear it [squawk].
A handwritten note on the nightstand: 'Derek - Rudebeak woke me up at 5AM. AGAIN. Do [SOMETHING] about that bird or I am calling my [lawyer].' - V.
An open box for top-of-the-line noise-canceling headphones. Purchase receipt inside: [yesterday's date]. Someone finally [snapped].

localDeductionSentence: Two [Sound-Proof Cases] came upstairs per the manifest entry [Delivery Manifest] - right when Derek blamed that [Hallway Rumble] on the dinner cart.
